conditions: The publisher checks the consent status on each SDK session
effects: Sets the consent status for the Appnext SDK

conditions: Positive consent is provided by the end-user
effects: The SDK will operate under the assumption that consent to collect personal data has been granted

conditions: Negative consent is provided by the end-user
effects: The SDK will refrain from collecting personal data

conditions: The end-user consent status must be forwarded manually if using other SDKs like Mopub
effects: Sets parameters for the Appnext SDK based on the end-user's consent
Updates the Appnext SDK with the current consent status
